DEENDescriptionVerdict: The fixed monohybrid pedigree interpretation body remains coherent; autosomal/sex-linked and dominant/recessive alternatives are linked inference dimensions of one pedigree decision, and interpretation limits avoid certainty from insufficient data. DE and EN agree.
scientificRationale: Dominant/recessive inheritance and simplified gamete/meiosis concepts are prerequisite knowledge for monohybrid family inheritance. Nucleotide/double-helix/replication mechanisms are not prerequisite evidence for visible autosomal/sex-linked distribution. A supplied accurate pedigree legend and Gonosomen model can provide the notation/context; the learner still infers plausible patterns and explains limits. No global body scope is removed.
sourceCoverageHOLD: NI FW6-009 demands explanatory diploidy/recombination consequences in actual family-tree work, not only pattern labeling. Current candidate text/edge alone does not bind that extra explanation as sufficient performance.
